profile.name: Muhammad Faizan Rauf
profile.title: Senior Software and AI/ML Engineer | Solution Architect | Cloud Systems
profile.tagline: Building distributed systems, AI-powered automation, and cloud infrastructure
profile.summary: Senior Software and AI/ML Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing distributed systems, AI-powered automation, and cloud infrastructure across FinTech, healthcare, e-commerce, and IoT. Translates business requirements into technical designs as a solution architect, covering API-first design, event-driven microservices, and multi-tenant integrations. Builds AI workflows with the Anthropic API, enterprise RAG, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and multi-agent orchestration. Delivered production systems including marketplace integrations across 5+ partner APIs, read-only FHIR access to Epic and Cerner, and real-time cloud-to-device HVAC communication. Builds backends with Next.js, NestJS, and Python, deploys on AWS with Docker and CI/CD, and mentors engineers through code reviews and architecture guidance.

description: Design event-driven microservices as a solution architect with Next.js, NestJS, and TypeScript, with clear service boundaries and data ownership.

Build AI orchestration workflows using the Anthropic API, RAG pipelines, and MCP-connected agents for cross-platform automation, backed by Python data-processing and machine learning pipelines (NumPy, Pandas).
Connect cloud applications to commercial HVAC equipment using Socket.IO and Modbus for real-time device communication.
Configure AWS and Docker environments, troubleshoot releases, and optimize application performance; mentor engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and architecture discussions.
Led architecture and development of the consumer web platform, admin console, and scalable MongoDB-backed APIs in collaboration with product and design teams.
Built data-preparation workflows and API integrations supporting AI/ML features and operational automation.
Optimized Docker environments and AWS deployment pipelines with infrastructure teams to enable continuous releases for web and API services.
Designed Python data-processing and visualization scripts for analytical software.
Automated data ingestion and repetitive data-handling workflows, reducing manual processing effort.
Developed web services and MongoDB-backed data layers for client applications.
Implemented unit tests, resolved defects, and improved application performance.
Built Java and Kotlin mobile applications with modular client components and MongoDB-backed backend integrations.

testimonials.name: Junaid Hassan
testimonials.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
testimonials.quote:
I had the privilege of collaborating closely with Faizan for a span of 8 months at PureLogics, and I can attest to his outstanding skills and contributions in the realm of Node.js development.

Faizan is an exemplary resource when it comes to Node.js. His proficiency in this technology is truly remarkable, and he consistently demonstrated his expertise by tackling complex challenges with ease. His ability to craft elegant and efficient solutions is a testament to his deep understanding of Node.js and its ecosystem.

Faizan is an individual who thrives in dynamic environments. Throughout our collaboration, he consistently exhibited a high level of energy and enthusiasm, which was contagious to our entire team. He never shied away from any challenge, approaching each task with a remarkable blend of determination and innovation.

One of Faizan's standout qualities is his impeccable time management. In a fast-paced field like Node.js development, his aptitude for staying organized and meeting deadlines was invaluable. Faizan has a knack for maintaining focus and delivering results, making him a highly reliable team member.

Furthermore, Faizan's commitment to his professional growth is commendable. He has a voracious appetite for staying updated with the latest trends and advancements in the Node.js ecosystem, ensuring that he remains at the cutting edge of technology.

I have no doubt that Faizan will continue to excel in his career and contribute significantly to any project or organization he is a part of. It was a pleasure working alongside him, and I wholeheartedly endorse him to anyone seeking an exceptional Node.js developer. Faizan's dedication and talent make him a true asset in the world of web development. Wishing him continued success in his endeavors.

testimonials.name: Stephen Chin
testimonials.title: Founder, HelloCustom
testimonials.quote: HelloCustom’s personalization and order-fulfillment workflows benefited from Faizan’s thoughtful full-stack approach. Connecting Amazon, Etsy, Printify, Printful, and other partners called for clear, maintainable application logic, and he kept the customer journey in focus throughout. His attention to API behavior, edge cases, and reliable automation made him a valuable contributor to the project.
